notes.title: What the Steam Drops Guide!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/f086a685f196d0a6e7bfa747d2086d92c870c0f8.jpg

Welcome, Squads!

The Seal: WHAT the FUN Dev Team is excited to introduce the latest feature: Steam Drops. This new addition brings a fun and collectible aspect to your gaming experience, allowing you to earn, trade, and showcase unique cards featuring your favorite characters.

What are Steam Drops?

Steam Drops are collectible items that you can earn by playing Seal: WHAT the FUN on the Steam platform. These items can be displayed on your Steam profile or traded on the Steam Marketplace, adding a social and competitive element to your game.

How to Earn Steam Drops

Daily Challenges
Complete Daily Challenges that refresh every 24 hours, such as passing specific rounds, capturing crowns, or winning matches.


 1 Drop per Daily Challenge completed.
 Maximum: 5 Drops per day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/ab28dadcdf39f9d186b35e51b865c6ab516b0dcc.gif

Connection Time

You can also earn Steam Drops simply by staying connected in the game:


 1 Drop for 1 minute of connection.
 1 additional Drop for 2 hours of connection.
 1 additional Drop for 4 hours of connection.
 Maximum: 3 Drops per day.
 Resets daily at 01:00 UTC.

Types of Steam Item Cards

[olist]
 Normal Cards:
Feature characters from Seal: WHAT the FUN with either game map backgrounds or simple black backgrounds. These are the most common and easiest to collect.

 Special Cards:
Rare and highly sought-after, these come in three variants: Bronze, Silver, and Gold, featuring characters as metallic figures against vibrant, futuristic backgrounds.

 Joker Card (Event Exclusive):
An event-exclusive card offering unique, high-value rewards. 
[/olist]
Note: The Joker Card cannot be traded on the Steam Marketplace.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/0c63d4663ddf4398a26a4d123f7819452ba38c92.gif

Trading and Marketplace


 All Steam Drops, except the Joker Card, can be traded on the Steam Marketplace.
 Exchange your collectibles with other players or sell them for Steam Wallet funds.

Viewing Your Inventory


 An icon has been added to the upper right corner of the street in the game.
 This icon will shake when you earn a Steam Drop by completing a daily challenge.
 Selecting the icon will display your Steam inventory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/02b8c2bd132f32490259522e15c372b094a329ca.gif

Notification Settings

To receive notifications when you obtain Steam Drops:
[olist]
 Open Notifications in the Settings of the Steam client.
 Check “I receive a new item in my inventory” under STEAM NOTIFICATION.
 Enable “Toast notification in the Steam Client” to display alerts at the bottom right of your screen.
 Enable “Push notification in the Mobile App” to receive alerts on mobile devices with the Steam app. [/olist]
Don't miss out on the excitement—join us in Early Access today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2347910/Seal_WHAT_the_FUN/ 

Let's get ready to rumble! 

Seal: WHAT the FUN Team.

 Single Item 'Gloves'  added for each character.


Challenges

 5 additional "Food" emotes can be earned from achievements.
 Some of the achievements are changing as shown below. 
 Progress on the Challenge will be maintained, but after the changes, you must meet the new conditions for the progress to increase.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Before the Change[/th]
        [th]After Change[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]A for Effort
- Make it through any round
[/td]
        [td]Hit the Ground Running
- Finish round 1 within the top 8
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Re-entry
- Participate in round 2
[/td]
        [td]It’s Not Too Late
- Finish round 2 within the top 6
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Third Time's the Charm
- Participate in round 3
[/td]
        [td]Happiness Is First Come, First Served
- Finish round 3 within the top 4
[/td]
    [/tr]
 [tr]
        [td]A-team
- Make it through a team round
[/td]
        [td]Target Spotted
- Score 10 points or more
[/td]
    [/tr]
 [tr]
        [td]Team Carrier
- Place first on your team in a score round: team play
[/td]
        [td]Top Scorers
- Place first in the score round
[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]


[Improvements]
Gameplay Improvements

The rules of the round will be changed from the previous Knock out system to the Winning Point system.
There will no longer be a team rounds.


  The maximum number of players has been changed 20 → 10
  The minimum number of players required for a match has been changed 8 → 6
  There will be a total of 3 rounds. (Team rounds are no longer available.)
Round 1: Race 
Round 2: Score, Crown Capture
Round 3: Race, Crown Capture, Survival
  The time limit for all rounds is now 1 minute and 30 seconds. 
After 1 minute, “Fever Time” will run for the remaining 30 seconds.
“Extra Time” is no longer displayed.
  At the end of each round, a "Round result" will occur.
  There will be no eliminations based on the outcome of the round.
  You will earn "Victory Points" based on the rank you achieve in each round.
  At the end of the final round (Round 3), the "Victory Points" earned during the match wil determine the final rankings and winner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/38efe1e13237c90473a641b55ceb207599a21d98.jpg


Round Rules
Race Round

  Round ranking will be determine by the order in which you reach the finish line.
  As soon as someone achieves first place, Fever Time will be immediately activated, and the round ends when the Fever Time ends.
  For players that do not reach the finish line will have their ranking determined based on how close they are to the finish line, the closer the better.
  At the end of the round, you will be awarded victory points based on your ranking.


Score Round
 Depending on the type of game, a "Game Score" is calculated, and the higher the score, the higher the ranking.
 You will be ranked based on the "Game Score" you earn in the game, and you will be awarded victory points accordingly. 

Score-Push
Drop Zone, Rocket Attack
 You earn points when an opponent you've hit comes into contact with the dead zone.
 You lose points if you are hit by an opponent or if you yourself come into contact with the dead zone.

Score- Hit
Paintball Strike, Sprinkler, Bang-Bang Paintball: Rooftop, Bounce-Bounce Superball:Rooftop
 You earn points for hitting your opponent, but you do not lose points if your opponent hits you.

Score - Whack-a-Mole
 Points are gained or lost depending on which mole you hit.

Crown Capture

 If you have a crown, you will have 50 points as long as you hold the crown.
 If you lose the crown, you will lose the 50 points.
 1 second is made up of 60 ticks, and if you complete all 60 ticks, you will get 1 point.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/f2637bac71f2493de1e29782f34e0f475bb68a59.jpg
 If you lose your crown before reaching 60 ticks, the accumulated amount of tickets will not be reset, and if you take the crown again, you will start with the previously recorded tick.
 In Round 2, the number of spawned Crowns will be equal to 50% of the players amount.
 In Round 3, the number of spawned Crowns will be equal to 25% of the players amount.

Survival
 Rankings are assigned in reverse order of elimination.
 Survival time is the basis for ranking.
 The user who survives the longest until the end of the round takes first place.

Other Systems
 Steam items will be added, now you can play and collect steam items!
 Due to overall game improvements, the amount of XP needed for pass has been adjusted.
 Japanese language has been added.
 Added labels for the top menu UI.

Additional Notice
If you experience any issues after the update, please perform a File Integrity Check. 

Keep an eye on our social media channels for more updates and exciting reveals:

notes.title: What the DEV NOTES #5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/f51a917841a5f4b8241c0334381b701da0b7479f.jpg

Hello, Squads!

This is the Seal: WHAT the FUN Dev Team.

It has been a little over two months since the Early Access release of Seal: WHAT the FUN on May 3rd.

During this time, we have received a considerable amount of support and feedback from players. Our dev team has taken all feedback to heart and is dedicated to continually improving the game based on it.

Therefore, we would like to give an overlook of the changes and improvements of the game systems that will be included in the upcoming August update.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Introducing the Point System 

Many players have expressed a desire for faster gameplay and shorter overall play time. Based on this feedback, we decided to introduce a point system to the game. 

Unlike the current Knockout System, where players are eliminated if they fail to reach a certain goal for each round, the Point System allows players to participate in all rounds.

Players will now earn “Round Rank” points based on their performance in each round. 

These points will be used to calculate the “Total Rank” of each player, which will update after each round to show the current ranking. 

Once all rounds are complete, the final ranking is determined based on the accumulated points. The player with the highest total rank is the winner.

2. Suspension of the Team Play Mode

We have received considerable feedback indicating that the team play mode in Round 2 is perceived as unfair. As a result, we have decided to suspend the Team Play mode. All rounds will now proceed in Solo Play mode.

The Team Play mode will make a comeback in future events or in another form, so we kindly ask players who enjoy it to keep a close eye on upcoming content updates.

3. Modification of the Win Conditions for the Capture the Crown Round

With the introduction of the points system and the suspension of the Team Play mode, we have modified the win conditions for the Capture the Crown Round.

From now on players holding the crown will earn “Acquisition Points” and “Retention Points”, based on the duration for which the crown is held. If the crown is stolen, the “Acquisition Points” will be deducted and transferred to the new crown holder. 

By placing more emphasis on acquiring and retaining the crown we are striving to satisfy all players with more dynamic gameplay.

4. Addition of Steam Items
One of the latest Steam trends is the rise of games that encourage the trading of items obtained during gameplay. We have decided to incorporate this feature into Seal: WHAT the FUN as well.

By completing daily challenges, players can earn Steam items that can be traded on the Steam market. These items can be viewed in the Steam inventory.

This feature is meant to enhance the fun of collecting trading items, and we hope that you, the players, enjoy it!


Our dev team deeply appreciates your support and positivity. We wish to give back to our awesome player base by constantly researching new ways to improve the game and make it more enjoyable for you!

We hope you continue to look forward to the evolution of Seal: WHAT the FUN!
Thank you once again.

Look forward to seeing more on our official communities.
We will be sharing more exciting news & events soon!

We are pleased to announce the following updates on June 7.

[New Content] 
'Rooftop' Map added
New rounds available!

11 types of rounds are added.
(rooftop) Circular Seesaw Race - Race / Solo
(rooftop) Mosquito Coil Survivors - Survival / Solo
(rooftop) Urban Climbing – Race / Solo
(rooftop) What-A-Mole – Score / Solo
(rooftop) Crank Chasm Survivors – Survival / Solo
(rooftop) Treasure Hoard: Rooftop – Score / Team
(rooftop) Up and Down – Race / Solo
(rooftop) Humpty Dumpty – Race / Solo
(rooftop) Bang-Bang Paintball: Rooftop – Score / Team
(water bomb) Crown Scramble: Water Bomb – Capture the crown / Solo
(playroom) Crown Scramble: Playroom – Capture the crown / Solo

Added new round types
- Score / Solo Play
- 2nd round / Solo play


Shop Update

 'Space Opera' costume sets and separate pieces added for each character.
 'Waterbomb' different color costume sets added for each character.


Emote

  7 New "Space Opera" expressions have been added and can be obtained from Challenges.


Name Tag

  2 New sets of "Space Opera" name tags have been added and can be obtained from Challenges.


Challenge

  Added new Challenge "Re-entry".


[Improvements, changes and bug fixes]
Improved Training

 4 rounds have been added.
 It has been changed to a full pop-up screen.
 It now supports all input devices (gamepads, keyboards, and mouse).
 When entering training, the character set by the Squad will be used.
 When training, you can check your personal record for each section. 


Improved Authority Party Progression System

  The party leader's server is now also displayed in the  small party button displayed in the left side of the screen in the street.


Level Design Improvements
Item

 The duration  of the "Shield" available in Round 2 will be shortened
 Increased the radius of "Power Up"
 "Slime Gun" and "Ice Gun" will now knock-back anyone who is affected by its area of effect.

Other
 The knockback speed of the basic punch has been improved.

Round 1

 (Waterbomb) Removed some of the bumpers from "The Narrow Bridge 3"
 (Waterbomb) Reduced the speed of the rotator in "Rumble Tumble 3"
 (Playroom) Reduced the speed of the rotator in "Trampoline Race 3"


Round 2

 (Playroom) In "Air Hockey", the puck's respawn point will be changed to the left/right side of the center circle.


Improved round rules
Race / Solo Play
- The number of people who can pass the round does not change even if some squads leave. However, if  the number of all squads participating in the round is less than the set number of people passing, the number of people passing is recalculated.


Other Systems

 You can check “Global Leaderboards” on Steam. Run towards the top!
 The types for the rounds below will be changed
-	(Playroom) Crawl & Drill: Survival → Race
-	(Waterbomb) Crown Chase Solo: Survival → Capture the crown
 Once the matching is successful, a sound effect (SFX) will be played.
 If you are eligible to claim a reward through the Season Pass or Achievements, a red dot will be displayed.
 On the play screen, the name of the round you are currently playing and the network connection status are displayed.
 Now you can change hte camera controls and audio-related settings during a round.
 Inactivity detection system changes:
-	After 20 seconds without any key (or button) input, a "warning pop-up" will be displayed.
-	After 10 seconds of displaying the warning pop-up, go  the squad will be sent to the street.
 In the case of eliminated players, the “Exit” button is displayed immediately in various directions (“Advance to the next round”, “Final winner”).
 "Round Preview" has been shortened: 20 seconds → 10 seconds
 Language and Graphic Quality change option now has a pop-up menu to select your desired choice.
 You can now check the in-game leaderboard and users who were disconnected while advancing to the next round.


Fixes

 In "How to Play", the button icon for "Jump" has been fixed: Enter → Space


Additional Notice
If you experience any issues after the update, please perform a File Integrity Check.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/1cba4403623b78dcd9f0dffd4342f59f0caaa25b.jpg

We are pleased to announce the following updates on May 10.

[New Content] 
'Training' mode
Now you can practice on your own!

 19 rounds available (18 types of round 1, and 1 type of round 3).
 If the round type is Race, your clear time for each race will be recorded. Keep challenging yourself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/fe9ec6d3d57dcdb2b9e87065bc1eb021dec12818.jpg

Authority Party Progression System

 When an authorized account (Game Master or Content Creator) creates a party, a button is created in the street (lobby) to join the party.
 Up to four party join buttons can be created.
 When selecting the button, you can enter directly without entering the "Invitation Code".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/60b2fcdf2bea114e03426f68448ac356019e5fb1.jpg

[Improvements, changes and bug fixes]
Party System changes

 The maximum number of people in a party changed: 20 → 10.
 Added UI to indicate the server region of the party leader.
 Added a "Quick Start" feature that automatically starts after 5 seconds when the maximum number of people join.
 Removed the "Rejoin Party" feature that was available in the results screen.



Level Design Improvements
ROUND1

 (Waterbomb) The difficulty of the seesaw section in the Rumble Tumble 1 minigame was reduced.
 (Playroom) The interference between the trampoline and the rotator in the final section of the Trampoline Race minigame was removed.
 (Playground) The bounce of the trampoline in the final section of the Trampoline Race 2 minigame was increased.
 (Playroom) The difficulty of the "Rubber Duck Shooter" in the Trampoline Race 3 minigame was reduced.
 (Playroom) The size of the 'Moving Bumper Pillars' in the Maze Mayhem 3 minigame was reduced.


ROUND2

 (Playroom) The wind strength of the fan in the Crown Chase Freeze Tag minigame was increased.
 (Waterbomb) The "High Jump" item is no longer available in the Paintball Strike minigame.
 (Playroom) The "High Jump" item is no longer available in the Sprinkler minigame.
 (Playroom) Climb issue has been fixed, to prevent characters from climbing on top of the walls on the Sprinkler minigame.
 (Waterbomb) The issue where toy guns could be fired through terrain in the Paintball Strike minigame has been fixed.


Other Systems

 The minimum number of Squads to start a game was changed: 11 → 8.
 Squads are automatically sent to the street (lobby) after 30 seconds of inactivity during gameplay (except in Training mode).
 "When Show Names" [Tab] [Button] is enabled during gameplay, it will be maintained until all rounds are completed.
 You can now go to the Streets (Lobby) by using the "To the Streets" button on the exit screen or by pressing the ESC button.


BUG FIX

 Fixed an issue where certain characters (letters) were not displayed correctly in Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
 Fixed an issue where the amount of cash held was not immediately updated after recharging cash.
 Fixed an issue where the achievement count for 'Re-Entry 02' in Steam achievements could not exceed 100.
 Changed the goal count for "Weekly Endeavors" in Steam Achievements from 1000 to 100.
 Changed the achievement description for "Unlucky Runners-up" in Steam Achievements from 'Place first in round 2' to 'Place second in round 1'.
 Changed the achievement description for "Still in the top" in Steam achievements from 'Place first in round 3' to 'Place third in round 1'.
 Fixed Issue with Weekly Mission 'Daily Endeavors'.

notes.title: What the DEV NOTES!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44809576/f51a917841a5f4b8241c0334381b701da0b7479f.jpg

Hello, Squads! This is the Seal: WHAT the FUN Dev Team.

We want to say a big thank you to everyone who joined our Beta Test and participated with such enthusiasm.

Our Dev Team is always working hard on bringing you a better gaming experience, so we kindly ask for your generous support and encouragement.

We hope that by providing some comments on the valuable feedback you sent us with during the Beta Test, we can address some of your burning questions about the game.

We are taking all your feedback into consideration and will use it to improve the game, so stay tuned!

We will continue sharing updates and FUN news on our X(Twitter) and Discord, so please join us there!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FAQ

Q. When is the official release date, or when is Early Access available?
A. Early Access for our game will begin on May 3, 2024. 
05:00 MAY 3rd (GMT-7)
19:00 MAY 3rd (GMT+7)

Q. Are there plans to release a mobile version?
A. Currently, we do not have plans to announce for a mobile version. We are dedicated to expanding our game's availability to accommodate the varied preferences of our community. 

Feedback about the game

Q. The in-game announcements are too large.
A. We plan to adjust the size of these announcements to better fit the game screen.

Q. Some rounds are too difficult.
A. We are actively working on balancing the gameplay to ensure a more enjoyable experience for all skill levels. 

Q. How many types of rounds are there?
A. Currently, there are 38 types of rounds in the game. We're doing our best to add more maps and rounds to enrich your gaming experience.

Q. The camera view is obstructed or limited during certain rounds.
A. We are already working on camera improvements to provide a smoother and more immersive gameplay experience.  

Q. I wish there were more item types. (Items from the random boxes)
A. Our Development Team is continuously exploring new ideas and actively researching to expand the variety of items available in the game. If you have good ideas please share them with us.

Q. I wish we could jump while pushing or shooting!
A. Currently, our development team is reviewing all feedback and suggestions closely. While we can't promise immediate changes, pushing or shooting feature has been noted and will be considered in our planning discussions.

Q. Please add an ‘accept all’ button when receiving items to the inventory from the Challenges or Early Pass.
A. 'Accept all' button will be available soon.

Q. I wish I could choose which map to play!
A. We will introduce this feature during events or a new game mode in the future. Stay tuned!

Q. There is an issue when I try to join a party.
A. We are aware that some players are experiencing difficulties when trying to join parties. Our team is actively working on a fix to ensure a smoother experience, and we plan to have this issue resolved in our Early Access.

Q. The sound is suddenly so loud!
A. It seems there was an issue with the volume levels in our game that was causing sudden loud sounds for some players. We've identified and addressed this problem, ensuring that the volume levels are now stable and consistent for all players.

Once again, thank you to all Beta Test participants! 

For more information and fun news check out our communities:
Discord: https://discord.gg/sealwhatthefun   
Twitter: https://twitter.com/SealWHATtheFUN   
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@SealWhatTheFun  

Stay tuned for more announcements.

See you in EARLY ACCESS!
